mithral-a.reason: The three separated pieces break the ingot silhouette; the central core is a small bright spot at 16 px.

mithral-b.reason: The two broad crescents retain a cleaner horizontal gap at 16 px. Recommended over A.

cold-iron-a.reason: The tall ore wedge breaks the ingot family, but its narrow shape is small in a chip.

cold-iron-b.reason: The deep split reads as a U at 20 px and gives more width at 16 px. Recommended over A.

ethereal-silica-a.reason: The curved glass has an open S outline at all tested sizes; separates from ice without relying on green. Recommended.

ethereal-silica-b.reason: The green fan separates from ice, but joins the pointed crystal family. Less distinct across the full set than A.

deep-crystal-a.reason: The dark cavity and pale geode rim survive 16 px, unlike the shipped cluster tips. Recommended.

deep-crystal-b.reason: The horizontal geode separates from quartz but has less open cavity at 16 px than A.

dragonhide-a.reason: The pointed single scale removes the log-shaped cylinder and matches the lore. Recommended.

dragonhide-b.reason: The spread removes the round log end, but becomes a broad red-brown patch at 16 px.

knight-t3-a.reason: The broad red fan persists above the steel head at 16 px and distinguishes the plain T2 helmet. Recommended.

knight-t3-b.reason: The enlarged tall plume remains close to the shipped silhouette; the fan gives a larger shape change.

crossbowman-t2-a.reason: A broader kettle brim changes too little of the shipped portrait at 16 px. Keep for comparison, not recommended.

crossbowman-t2-b.reason: The raised crossbow creates a taller asymmetric outline while retaining a soldier holding it. Recommended.

paladin-t2-a.reason: The wide silver wings produce a broader helmet silhouette than the bare T1 and hooded T3. Recommended.

paladin-t2-b.reason: The crest and hammer distinguish the tier, but a hammer changes the weapon association. Prefer A.

stamina-relic-2-a.reason: The round face and side lugs separate tier II from the narrow tier I tablet at chip size. The large motif remains legible. Recommended.

stamina-relic-2-b.reason: The twin tablet is wider than tier I, but the V notch and seam weaken at 16 px; it remains closer to the shipped rectangle. Prefer A.
